1-ai-engineer.html.name: The AI Engineer
top3: Anthropic says new anti-distillation defenses cut harvested reasoning data by 90–99% — and 'preserved thinking' means some API integrations must change.
Agent Skills (the SKILL.md standard) moves to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation next to MCP; Anthropic cites 70+ platforms and ~1M published skills.
Spring AI keeps maturing: Session Memory replaces ChatMemory in 2.1 RC1, and the new Modular RAG + Jev recipe filters prompt-injected chunks before they reach the prompt.
1-ai-engineer.html.tag: AI engineering, in depth — models, agents, Spring AI, MCP, RAG

2-dev-digest.html.name: The Dev Digest
top3: Spring now ships every project on one monthly 'Patch Thursday' — by that rule the next train lands Thu Nov 19, the same day PostgreSQL 19 is scheduled to go GA.
GitHub Actions is tightening: ubuntu-latest moves to 26.04 by Nov 19 and pull_request_target is blocked by default in public repos from Dec 2 — check your workflows now.
Razorpay got its IFSCA licence for global money transfers and is reportedly heading to an IPO; Stripe is turning agent payments into a product line.
2-dev-digest.html.tag: Java & Spring, Node & Python, career, security and the rest of the stack

3-daily-extras.html.name: The Daily Extras
top3: Tool: Open WebUI 0.13 lets coding agents like Claude Code and Codex show up in the model picker — plus an 'Auto' mode where a review model decides which tool calls need approval.
Repo: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui (17.4k★) — an open event protocol that connects agents to React front ends, with Java and Kotlin SDKs.
Project idea: a Spring AI 'support desk' agent with Session Memory, modular RAG and prompt-injection filtering — a tutorial built on this month's newest APIs.
3-daily-extras.html.tag: Tools, repos, project ideas and one thing to learn today
